method: OpenAI built-in image generation: style transfer and panoramic reframing
reference: User-supplied photograph of wind-bent grass in mist
prompt: Edit the attached grass photograph into a detailed ASCII-art website banner. Use the photo as the composition reference: wind-bent grasses and seed heads in the foreground, a low rolling ridge dipping in the middle and rising at the right, and open mist above. Crop away much of the empty upper sky and some of the darkest bottom foreground to make a very wide, shallow panoramic header, ideally about 6:1. Keep both the misty horizon and recognizable individual grass blades. Completely replace the photographic rendering with high-resolution line-printer ASCII ART: hundreds of small, crisp, consistently sized MONOSPACED characters aligned on a regular dense character grid. Form the fine grass stems from /, backslash, vertical bar, parentheses, quotes and other ASCII marks; form seed heads and the distant field with tiny periods, colons, semicolons, plus signs and x marks. Use character density and whitespace for all shading and depth. The individual glyphs should be discernible on close inspection while the field reads clearly at header size. Flat pale-blue #eaf1ff background, dark desaturated blue #3d4363 characters only. Preserve the quiet misty atmosphere, but remove the dark photographic vignette. Airy light fog in the upper quarter, increasingly detailed grasses through the middle and lower area, no heavy solid dark mass. This must look like a detailed ASCII conversion of the field, not a smooth engraving, pencil sketch, generic halftone, or text overlaid on a photo. Edge-to-edge landscape; no frame, title, caption, watermark, extra objects or scenery.
